$ greet hello
Hello, world!
[exit 0]

$ greet hello Ada -g Hi --times 2
Hi, Ada!
Hi, Ada!
[exit 0]

$ greet -v hello Grace
name="Grace" greeting="Hello" times=1
Hello, Grace!
[exit 0]

$ greet hello --times twice
greet: hello: invalid --times "twice" from flag --times: invalid syntax
[exit 2]

$ greet --help
Usage: greet <command> [options]

Greet someone.

Commands:
  hello  Print a greeting.

Options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env GREET_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print the options of the greeting.                                      env GREET_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ greet hello -h
Usage: greet hello [options] [NAME]

Print a greeting.

Arguments:
      NAME  Name to greet.  default "world"

Options:
  -g, --greeting string  Word of the greeting.  default "Hello", env GREET_HELLO_GREETING, key hello.greeting
  -n, --times int        Number of greetings.   default "1", env GREET_HELLO_TIMES, key hello.times

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env GREET_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print the options of the greeting.                                      env GREET_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ greet
Usage: greet <command> [options]

Greet someone.

Commands:
  hello  Print a greeting.

Options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env GREET_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print the options of the greeting.                                      env GREET_VERBOSE, key verbose

greet: missing command
[exit 2]

$ greet hello >/dev/full
greet: main: write the greeting: clitest: no space left on device
[exit 1]
